Sparse_Sweat_Gland_Dermis.description: Relatively bare skin possessing an evolutionary hyper-abundance of eccrine sweat glands. By completely sacrificing the insulation of thick fur, the entity unlocks staggering, unparalleled endurance by continuously evaporative cooling while running.

Dense_Primate_Fur.description: A thick, coarse coat of dark hair providing excellent protection against tropical rain, insect bites, and minor abrasions while moving through dense jungle undergrowth.
